# RafaSC

> RafaSC (Rafa, Barcelona) is a 3D and technical artist who makes stylized materials and shaders for Unreal Engine 5, sold on Fab, and takes commissions for stylized 3D props and game environments on Fiverr. This site has one page per product and step-by-step guides.

Prices are in US dollars as listed on Fab on 2026-11-15. Product facts below are the ones on each Fab listing.

## Products

- [Stylized Water Material](https://rafasc.dev/v2/stylized-water/): Stylized Water Material by RafaSC is a procedural water shader for Unreal Engine 5.8 that uses no texture files. It includes 6 presets (Ocean, Tropical, Pond, Swamp, River, Dirty), a spline river, a spline waterfall and a buoyancy component that makes objects ride the same waves the shader draws, without physics simulation. Version 1.0 has no underwater post-process and was tested only on UE 5.8 (DirectX 12, Windows). It is sold on Fab for $29.99.
- [Stylized Rope & Chain Physics Kit](https://rafasc.dev/v2/rope-kit/): Stylized Rope & Chain Physics Kit by RafaSC is a C++ rope physics plugin with a full Blueprint API for Unreal Engine 5.8. It includes 7 ready Blueprints (rope, chain, cable, vine, rope ladder, hanging lantern and walkable rope bridge), a winch, cutting and breaking by load, a component for characters to swing, climb and traverse, and multiplayer support for listen and dedicated servers. Its fixed-step solver gives the same result at 30, 60 or 120 fps and had 0 explosions in 378 test runs. Rope-to-rope collision is not included; it was tested on UE 5.8 (Windows, DirectX 12), with UE 5.5-5.7 and mobile not included. It is sold on Fab for $34.99.
- [See-Through Occlusion](https://rafasc.dev/v2/see-through/): See-Through Occlusion by RafaSC is a Material Function for Unreal Engine 5 that opens a hole in walls, roofs and trees between the camera and the character, so the player stays visible in top-down, isometric and third-person games. Floors are never cut and cut walls keep casting shadows. It needs Masked materials for the cut-out; a Silhouette post process is included for meshes that cannot be Masked. Tested on UE 5.5 and 5.8; not for the Path Tracer, mobile not tested. It is sold on Fab for $12.99.
- [Custom Toon Shaders Studio](https://rafasc.dev/v2/toon-studio/): Custom Toon Shaders Studio by RafaSC is a post-process toon and cel shader pack for Unreal Engine 5.8: one actor with 13 looks (toon, anime, manga, comic, Ghibli, watercolor, oil paint, neon, Moebius, sumi-e, sketch, pixel and outline only). Effects can be mixed between looks and saved as new presets, and looks can be blended at runtime. It needs the deferred renderer, works only on UE 5.8 and is not for UEFN or the Path Tracer. Measured cost is 0.3 to 1.9 ms per preset on an RTX 3080 at 1080p. It is sold on Fab for $29.99; a free Lite version with 3 looks is also on Fab.
- [Stylized Snow & Moss Coverage](https://rafasc.dev/v2/coverage/): Stylized Snow & Moss Coverage by RafaSC is a Material Function for Unreal Engine 5 that paints snow, moss, autumn leaves, sand, frost and other layers on top of any material, on every surface facing a chosen direction. It adds real thickness with World Position Offset, keeps the ground under roofs clean using Mesh Distance Fields, and includes Blueprints for runtime weather and melt zones. It has 12 presets, was tested on UE 5.5 and 5.8, and is not for the Path Tracer or UEFN. It is sold on Fab for $14.99.
- [Painted Edges Shader](https://rafasc.dev/v2/painted-edges/): Painted Edges Shader by RafaSC is a free Material Function for Unreal Engine 5 that paints a hand-painted band along the edges of a mesh without UVs, textures or baked curvature maps. It reads the mesh normal in object space, so the paint follows actors that are rotated or moved in the level (the mesh pivot should be aligned with the mesh axes), and it needs bevelled or smooth-normal edges. Tested on UE 5.5 and 5.8; not compatible with the Path Tracer. It is free on Fab.
- [Toon Studio Lite](https://rafasc.dev/guides/free-toon-shader-unreal-engine-5-8/): free toon shader for Unreal Engine 5.8 with three fixed looks (01 Toon, 02 Anime Soft, 13 Outline). One actor, no material changes. Free on Fab.

## Guides

- [How to Make Stylized Water in Unreal Engine 5](https://rafasc.dev/guides/stylized-water-ue5/): Stylized water in Unreal Engine 5 is a translucent material on a subdivided plane. It colours itself from the depth of the scene behind it, draws foam where the water touches geometry, and moves its vertices to make waves. You can build those layers yourself, or drop in a ready material and tune it.
- [How to Make Rope Physics in Unreal Engine 5](https://rafasc.dev/guides/rope-physics-unreal-engine-5/): Rope physics in Unreal Engine 5 can be done three ways: the Cable Component that ships with the engine (great for hanging wires, mostly visual), a chain of small physics bodies joined by Physics Constraints, or a dedicated rope solver. Ropes that must carry real weight, be cut, reeled in by a winch or climbed by a character need the last one.
- [Rope Swing and Rope Climbing in Unreal Engine 5](https://rafasc.dev/guides/rope-swing-climb-unreal-engine-5/): To let a character swing on a rope in Unreal Engine 5, the rope has to be simulated (not animated) and the character has to grab a point of it and feed its movement input into the rope. Free ropes give a swing, rope ladders give a climb, and ropes fixed at both ends give a hand-over-hand traverse. A walkable bridge also needs planks that sag under the character's weight.
- [See the Player Through Walls in Unreal Engine 5](https://rafasc.dev/guides/see-player-through-walls-unreal/): To see your character through walls in Unreal Engine 5 you either cut a hole in the wall material between the camera and the character, or draw the hidden part of the character on top with a Custom Depth post process. The cut-out gives the Diablo-style open roof and needs Masked materials. The silhouette works with any material, including assets you bought.
- [Free Toon Shader for Unreal Engine 5.8: Setup](https://rafasc.dev/guides/free-toon-shader-unreal-engine-5-8/): Toon Studio Lite is a free toon shader for Unreal Engine 5.8. You drag one actor into the level and the whole scene gets a 3-tone cel look with an ink outline, without editing a single material. It ships three looks: Toon, Anime Soft and Outline.
- [UE 5.8 Toon Shader vs Post-Process Toon: Which One?](https://rafasc.dev/guides/ue-5-8-toon-shader-vs-post-process/): Unreal Engine 5.8 added toon shading inside Substrate, and it stylizes one material at a time. A post-process toon shader restyles the whole finished frame without touching any material. They solve different problems: the first is for art you are building, the second is for a scene that already exists.
- [Add Snow or Moss on Top of Any Mesh in UE5](https://rafasc.dev/guides/snow-moss-on-any-mesh-ue5/): To put snow or moss on top of any mesh in Unreal Engine 5, blend a second surface over your material wherever the surface faces up in world space. Because the test is done in world space, the snow stays on top when you rotate, scale or move the object, even at runtime.
- [Runtime Snow and Melt Zones in Unreal Engine 5](https://rafasc.dev/guides/runtime-snow-melt-weather-ue5/): Runtime snow in Unreal Engine 5 is one global number that every snow material reads: raise it and winter arrives, lower it and the snow melts. Put that number in a Material Parameter Collection and any Blueprint can drive it. A second parameter with a position and a radius gives you melt zones around a campfire or the player.
- [Hand-Painted Edge Wear in UE5 Without Baking](https://rafasc.dev/guides/hand-painted-edge-wear-ue5/): You can get hand-painted edge wear in Unreal Engine 5 without baking a curvature map. Read the mesh normal in object space and keep the middle value of its three absolute components: it is 0 on flat faces and peaks in the centre of every bevelled edge. Painted Edges is a free Material Function that does exactly this, with no UVs and no textures.
- [Cel Shading With a Post Process in UE5 Explained](https://rafasc.dev/guides/cel-shader-post-process-ue5/): A post-process cel shader in Unreal Engine 5 runs after the scene is rendered. It reads the G-Buffer of the frame and redraws the light as flat bands, then adds ink lines. It can restyle a whole level without touching a single material, but it needs the deferred renderer and it has a few traps with exposure and Movie Render Queue.
- [Make Objects Float on Water in UE5 Without Physics](https://rafasc.dev/guides/floating-objects-buoyancy-ue5/): Objects can float on a custom water material in Unreal Engine 5 without physics simulation if a Blueprint evaluates the same wave formula as the shader. It samples the wave height under the object, moves it up and down and tilts it from a few sample points. That keeps boats and barrels on the waves you actually see.
- [Build a River and Waterfall With Splines in UE5](https://rafasc.dev/guides/spline-river-waterfall-ue5/): The easiest way to make a river in Unreal Engine 5 is a spline: you draw the riverbed with spline points and a Blueprint lays mesh segments along it with a flowing water material. The same idea pointed downwards gives you a waterfall with foam at the base.
- [Free UE5 Materials: Painted Edges and a Toon Shader](https://rafasc.dev/guides/free-ue5-materials/): I publish two free packs for Unreal Engine 5 on Fab. Painted Edges is a Material Function that paints hand-painted edges on a mesh with no UVs, no textures and no baking. Toon Studio Lite is a post-process toon shader for UE 5.8 with three looks. Both can be used in commercial projects under the Fab license.
- [Best Toon Shader for Unreal Engine 5 (2026)](https://rafasc.dev/guides/best-toon-shader-unreal-engine-5/): In 2026 there are four real ways to get a toon look in Unreal Engine 5: the built-in Substrate toon shading added in 5.8, a post-process pack that restyles any scene without touching materials, the free Lite version of a pack, and free community shaders from itch.io. Each solves a different problem. This page compares them honestly.
- [UE5 Outline Shader: Post-Process Method Explained](https://rafasc.dev/guides/ue5-outline-shader-post-process/): An outline shader in Unreal Engine 5 runs in a post-process material after the scene renders. It samples the depth and normal buffers to find where surfaces change, and draws a line there. That line appears on every mesh in the scene without touching a single material.
- [Anime Shader for Unreal Engine 5: Cel Shading Setup](https://rafasc.dev/guides/ue5-anime-shader/): An anime shader in Unreal Engine 5 replaces the default lighting with flat tone bands, adds a coloured outline and softens the shadows so they read like hand-drawn anime art. A post-process anime shader does this across the whole scene without editing any material.
